```{r}
#| label: load-packages-data
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
```

```{r}
#| label: cps-pi-overlap

frequencies_cps <- read_excel("Frequencies PI and Cxn to CPS - Raw.xlsx")

frequencies_cps <- clean_names(frequencies_cps) |>
  mutate(denominator = case_match(denominator,
                                  "imprisoned  people" ~ "Imprisoned People",
                                  "incarcerated parents" ~ "Incarcerated Parents",
                                  "foster care children" ~ "Foster Care Children",
                                  "CPS-involved children" ~ "CPS Involved-Children"
                                  ))
```

```{r}
#| label: graph-
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4
frequencies_pivoted <- frequencies_cps |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(total, male, female, white, black, hispanic),
               names_to = "demographic",
               values_to = "proportion") |>
  filter(!is.na(proportion)) |>
  mutate(race = case_when(
    demographic %in% c("white", "black", "hispanic") ~ demographic,
    TRUE ~ "total"
  ),
  gender = case_when(demographic %in% c("male", "female") ~ demographic,
                     TRUE ~ "total")) |>
  select(-demographic)

frequencies_pivoted |>
  ggplot(aes(x = proportion, y = clean_name, 
             fill = gender, shape = race)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, 
             position = position_jitter(height = .15), 
             color = "black",
             show.legend = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~denominator, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("male" = "#86B6C3", "female" = "#D29141",
                                "total" = "white")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("black" = 22, "hispanic" = 24, 
                                "white" = 23, "total" = 21)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          text = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.text.y = element_markdown(),
          plot.caption.position = "plot",
          plot.caption = element_markdown(hjust = 0)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(shape = 21, color = "black"))) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap_gen((width = 25))) +
  xlim(0, 0.75) +
  labs(title = "CPS Contact and Parental Incarceration",
       x = "Proportion of Total Population",
       y = "Condition",
       shape = "Race/Ethnicity",
       fill = "Gender")
```
